summary: Connect AI risks, impacts, and controls to ESG disclosures, materiality, and board oversight. Explore the practical five-day course.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for AI-related sustainability evidence, controls, disclosures, or board oversight. It suits people with working familiarity in ESG reporting, risk, compliance, AI programmes, or corporate governance.
audience: Human Rights and Social Impact Specialists
modules: AI Governance and NIST AI RMF
CSRD and ESRS AI Disclosure Mapping
IFRS S1 and S2 AI Risks
OECD AI Principles and Social Impact
AI ESG Reporting and Board Decisions
prerequisites: Working familiarity with ESG or sustainability reporting, risk and compliance, AI-enabled programmes, or corporate governance is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Advanced AI model design and technical implementation are outside the course scope.
